name: quantconnect
description: QuantConnect LEAN algorithms. Python class inheriting QCAlgorithm.
anti_patterns: Forgetting to call SetWarmUp for indicators (first bars produce NaN signals).
Universe selection inside OnData (should be in CoarseSelectionFunction).
Calling History() every bar — latency balloon.
Using datetime.now() — LEAN replays; use self.Time.
Market orders at close without time-in-force awareness.
submission_requirements: Uses AddEquity/AddFuture/etc, not ad-hoc data fetching.
past_round_notes: Pure trend-following on SPY + bonds beats most sophisticated ideas on risk-adjusted metrics.
Intraday strategies often fail due to ignored liquidity/slippage.
Framework-based algorithms (Alpha + PortfolioConstruction + Risk + Execution) usually outperform monolithic OnData implementations.
prompt_addendum: Context: QuantConnect LEAN. Output a Python algorithm subclassing QCAlgorithm with Initialize() and OnData(). Use AlgorithmImports. Do NOT print STRATENGINE_STATS or use Backtrader.
